person.name: Rao Fenggui
person.tagline: Generative AI × art-design workflows, HCI & public cultural experience.

resume.summary: PhD student at the HK PolyU School of Design and a China Academy of Art-trained designer. Founder & lead of DesignAnything Lab (D&A Lab), working across generative AI, art-design workflows, HCI, public culture and creative education.

education.school: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University — School of Design
education.detail: PhD Student in Design · Asian Ergonomics Design (AED) Lab · Supervisor: Yan Tina Luximon

education.school: China Academy of Art — School of Design & Innovation
education.detail: B.Eng / B.Design in Innovative Design · GPA 90/100 · Ranked #1 in comprehensive assessment (2021–22 & 2022–23)

about.bio: I'm a designer-researcher who also builds. I take AI + design ideas from studio practice into working prototypes, public-facing experiences, papers and teachable workflows.
skills: Generative image/video pipelines, prompt systems, multimodal ideation, RAG / knowledge-base structuring, agentic workflow design and evaluation.
HCI study design, qualitative & quantitative analysis, design probes, interaction prototypes, CHI/DIS framing, academic writing.
AI art direction, speculative design, public cultural experience, exhibition narrative, product & interaction design.
Python, data analysis, frontend prototyping, interactive systems, Rhino / Blender / Unity, ControlNet / IP-Adapter visual workflows.

projects.d: A context-aware human-AI image co-creation system that brings real-world context into the generative loop.
An embodied Grand Canal soundscape installation with a provenance-aware cultural-asset workflow for authoring when historical records are scarce.
In-situ MR + generative-AI workflow for walking, capturing and reimagining small street micro-interventions.
An AIGC-driven immersive art-therapy approach designed to help children cope with nyctophobia (fear of the dark).
Between Real & Imagined — a Dynamic Immersive Virtual Auditing framework for high-density urban health trails.
Enhanced interactivity through embodied cognition and real-time physical visualization on swarm tangible interfaces.
A speculative AI/art installation on pet ethics and non-human ecology — a D&A Lab project selected for the DIS Art Gallery.
The Creative Journey of Plast-ocean — an AIGC-driven ecological-narrative interactive system exploring ocean plastic.
Public-culture collaboration using AI image generation and AR-style play to activate Song-dynasty cultural storytelling.

honors: KTK Jin Daiqiang Design Award — Finalist
roles: China Academy of Art · 2023–Present — an ongoing AI art-design lab & community across workshops, salons, exhibitions and project incubation.
Originated this AI art-exhibition IP and built its concept, public program, cross-school collaboration and hackathon format.
Teaching Assistant & URIS Peer Mentor — HK PolyU
Supported design teaching and mentored undergraduate research & innovation projects.
Peer review for CHI; contribution framing, method quality and reviewer-facing writing.
